subject.title: feat(sessions): upstream liveness for adopted catalog sessions

question: Should upstream activity become a public generic Session Catalog plugin contract now, or remain bundled-internal until the broader observed-session seam is designed?
rationale: The PR adds compatibility-sensitive Plugin SDK and persisted-state surfaces, while the current shape hardcodes bundled providers and crosses the Anthropic ownership boundary; code review cannot choose the permanent public contract.

options.title: Approve a generic plugin seam
options.body: Use opaque provider-defined source identities and markers, keep parsing provider-owned, and require agent-qualified results before exposing the API publicly.

options.title: Keep it bundled-internal
options.body: Remove the public SDK exports and route only the bundled Claude and Codex implementations through an internal facade until the API direction is settled.

options.title: Pause for SessionObserver design
options.body: Defer this PR and resolve the permanent observer, registry, and subscription contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/104804 first.

recommendation.title: Approve a generic plugin seam
recommendation.body: Use opaque provider-defined source identities and markers, keep parsing provider-owned, and require agent-qualified results before exposing the API publicly.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the adjacent merged session-state layers and authored the canonical observed-session design issue, making them the strongest available routing candidate.
